description: This file defines a final class DroppingStream that implements the PSR-7 StreamInterface. It acts as a decorator around another stream, dropping data once the maximum size is exceeded.

classes.name: DroppingStream
classes.description: A stream decorator that drops data once the underlying stream exceeds a maximum length.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the DroppingStream with an underlying stream and a maximum length.

methods.name: write
methods.description: Writes data to the stream, dropping data if the maximum size is exceeded.
